parts.text: Which claim about the study time is correct?

options.text: Study lasts $8$ hours because each box stands for one hour.
The colour label alone gives the duration without counting boxes.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Vivaan draws an activity strip for a $12$-hour stretch using $24$ equal boxes. Each box stands for $30$ minutes. Study is coloured in $8$ boxes.

part_answers.answer: Count the study boxes and multiply by $30$ minutes per box: $8\times 30=240$ minutes.

teacher.key_rationale: Eight boxes at 30 minutes each is 240 minutes; boxes are not one hour in this strip.
